name: 07_testConnection
description: testConnection sync action - token mint + compute_cost_only pre-flight (no quota).

name: 08_listObjects
description: listObjects sync action - one __schema introspection; classified into the extractable set.

name: 09_listFields_feedback
description: listFields sync action for feedback - the field catalogue (values replaced by a synthetic set at record time).

name: 10_listDateFields_feedback
description: listDateFields sync action for feedback - incremental-field candidates (DATE/DATETIME + sortable INT) from the same catalogue.

name: 11_validateQuery_preview
description: validateQuery sync action - cost pre-flight then a small live row preview (Keboola standard).

parameters.raw_query: query ($first: Int!, $after: ID) { feedback(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id a_customerid: fieldData(fieldId: "a_customerid") { values } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

name: 12_feedback
description: feedback (shape a, fieldData, node-id PK) incremental on the epoch finish field, bounded to a fixed 2h epoch window [1781542800,1781550000) so the recording stays small and deterministic.

name: 13_invitations
description: invitations (shape a, fieldData, node-id PK) incremental on the epoch finish field, bounded to the same fixed 2h epoch window as 12_feedback. Exercises the object-name path for a second object.

name: 14_invitations_full_load
description: invitations FULL_LOAD (overwrite write mode) bounded to the same fixed 2h epoch window; exercises the full-load write path (no watermark state persisted) vs the incremental cases.

name: 15_raw
description: raw mode - user Relay query paginated via $first/$after; full load, no state. Bounded by an in-query epoch filter (same 2h window) so pagination terminates quickly on a small slice.

parameters.raw_query: query ($first: Int!, $after: ID) { feedback(first: $first, after: $after, filter: {fieldIds: ["a_initial_finish_timestamp"], gte: "1781542800", lt: "1781550000"}) { nodes { id a_customerid: fieldData(fieldId: "a_customerid") { values } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
